description: This source file defines a composable UI screen for the Android app that manages gateway connection settings, including connecting/disconnecting, endpoint display, advanced controls, and onboarding workflow. It interacts with a ViewModel to manage state, handles user interactions, and displays diagnostic info.

classes.name: ConnectInputMode
classes.description: Enumeration to manage connection input modes: SetupCode or Manual.

methods.name: ConnectTabScreen
methods.description: Main composable function that displays and manages the connection interface, including connection status, endpoint info, advanced options, and onboarding.

methods.name: MethodChip
methods.description: Composable button representing a connection method option (e.g., Setup Code, Manual).

methods.name: QuickFillChip
methods.description: Quick preset button for host configurations like Android Emulator or Localhost.

methods.name: CommandBlock
methods.description: Displays a command snippet in a styled block for user guidance.

methods.name: EndpointPreview
methods.description: Displays the resolved gateway endpoint with dividers and monospace styling.

methods.name: outlinedColors
methods.description: Provides color configuration for outlined text fields.
